Up. 1. 2</ls>, <ls n="Praśna. Up.">6. 1</ls>. .²3 To have intercourse with (a woman), cohabit; वाच्यश्चानुपयन् पतिः <ls>Ms. 9. 4</ls>. .²4 To under go, perform, undertake, practise; तपः, सत्रम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 To go to or pass into any state; योगम् <ls>R. 16. 84</ls>; भेदम् <ls>Ku. 2. 4</ls>; to fall into (misfortune <ab>&c.</ab>); क्षयम्, मत्युम्, सुखम्, दुःखम्, निद्राम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 To obtain, attain to; तस्य प्रिया ज्ञातयः सुकृतमुपयन्ति <ls>Kauṣ. Up. 1. 1</ls>; उपैति शस्यं परिणामरम्यताम् <ls>Ki. 4. 22</ls>. .²7 To incur, be present at. .²8 To fall to oneʼs lot or share, befall; उद्योगिनं पुरुषसिंहमुपैति लक्ष्मीः <ls>Pt. 1. 361</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 27</ls>. .²9 To consider as, admit, acknowledge.
